control.description-key: Clickable, keyboard-accessible star rating bound to a whole-number column.

property.name: value
property.description-key: The rating value (whole number). Empty means not rated.

property.name: maxStars
property.description-key: How many stars to show (1-10). Default 5.

property.name: starColor
property.description-key: CSS colour for filled stars, e.g. #f5b301 or gold.
